title: Glowing watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glowing watering can body -->
  <rect x='28' y='42' width='44' height='34' rx='6' fill='#2ee6a8'/>
  <rect x='34' y='48' width='32' height='22' rx='4' fill='#7dffd0'/>
  <!-- top opening -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#1fbf88'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#a8ffe0'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M34 44 Q30 22 50 22 Q70 22 66 44' fill='none' stroke='#2ee6a8' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 44 Q30 22 50 22 Q70 22 66 44' fill='none' stroke='#9dffdd' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M28 56 L10 40 L14 34 L30 48 Z' fill='#1fbf88'/>
  <path d='M28 56 L10 40 L14 34 L30 48 Z' fill='none' stroke='#9dffdd' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rose / sprinkler head -->
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='36' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#7dffd0' transform='rotate(-38 12 36)'/>
  <circle cx='9' cy='33' r='1.4' fill='#e0fff5'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='31' r='1.4' fill='#e0fff5'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#e0fff5'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='37' r='1.4' fill='#e0fff5'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#e0fff5'/>
  <!-- water drops -->
  <circle cx='6' cy='28' r='2' fill='#a8ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#a8ffe0'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='26' r='1.8' fill='#a8ffe0'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <rect x='36' y='52' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e0fff5' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
